title: Preface
notes: The Preface is Volume 1’s; Volumes 2 and 3 print their own prefaces, which are not built. Its words about the three volumes are changed to the one book, each change noted; the resources it names are reached through the book page on OpenStax.org in the book’s words, without a link, and the one link it writes, to the Community Hubs, is kept.
